entities.summary: Marlo Morgan is an American author, best known for the bestselling book Mutant Message Down Under. She has also written Message from Forever (1998), another novel based on Australian Aboriginal themes. In 1996, she was confronted about the veracity of her book by Aboriginal protesters and stated that she never meant to hurt any of the people described in her book, whom she also stated that she loved.
